contrarianObservation.en: Two Temp Checks are live simultaneously — v4 Protocol Fee activation and Robinhood Chain fee expansion. If either passes, annualized revenue could jump 30-50%, potentially flipping UNI net-deflationary without touching price. Smart longs are front-running that governance optionality, not the current burn.
contrarianObservation.zh: 两项 Temp Check 同时在推进: v4 Protocol Fee 激活与 Robinhood Chain 费用扩张。任一通过, 年化收入可能跳升 30-50%, 有望在价格不变的情况下将 UNI 翻转为净通缩。聪明多头抢跑的是治理期权, 而非当下的 burn。

watchNext.en: Perp funding rate flipping positive on Binance — would confirm leveraged longs entering and set up a cleaner short trigger.

watchNext.en: Retest of $5.96 anchor as support versus resistance — behavior there defines the 1-4 week regime.
watchNext.zh: $5.96 锚点回测: 转为支撑还是压力, 将决定 1-4 周的走势结构。

fullReasoning.en: UNI ripped 14% weekly into $6.70, comfortably above the $5.96 treasury burn anchor for the first time in weeks. Skepticism is warranted. The bull narrative leans on fee switch mechanics, but the arithmetic still says net inflationary: 20M UNI emitted versus 6.7M burned at current price, leaving +1.49% dilution annually. Protocol revenue is real at $264M annualized, but the 17% buyback slice ($44.9M) doesn't cover emission until UNI trades sub-$2.25 or revenue roughly triples — neither is imminent. Derivatives expose the tape's fragility. OI is thin at $41.7M, funding is dead flat at 0.00%, yet Binance long/short account ratio sits at 1.76. Retail is piling in without paying carry, into a rally on just $20M daily spot volume. Textbook crowded long. Governance is more interesting than price action: v4 Protocol Fee activation and Robinhood Chain fee expansion are both in Temp Check. Either passing would materially reprice the buyback math. But neither is voted, and forum-stage RFCs routinely stall for months. No active real-yield proposal is visible in top threads, which is the actual regime-change trigger. Base case over 1-4 weeks: rally exhausts, mean-reverts toward the $5.96 anchor. Fade the pump, keep dry powder for the v4 fee vote.
fullReasoning.zh: UNI 一周暴涨 14% 至 $6.70, 数周来首次稳定站上 $5.96 国库销毁锚点。但仍需保持警惕。多头叙事依赖 fee switch 机制, 数据却显示 UNI 仍处净通胀状态: 年增发 20M 对应销毁 6.7M, 年净稀释 +1.49%。协议年化收入 $264M 确实扎实, 但 17% 的 buyback 预算仅 $44.9M, 除非 UNI 跌至 $2.25 以下或收入翻三倍, 否则销毁量无法覆盖增发, 短期均不现实。衍生品盘面暴露结构脆弱性: Binance 永续 OI 仅 $41.7M, funding rate 归零, 但账户多空比高达 1.76。散户零资金费率成本裸多入场, 而现货日成交仅 $20M, 流动性单薄, 是典型的拥挤多头。治理层面比价格更值得关注: v4 Protocol Fee 激活与 Robinhood Chain 费用扩张均处于 Temp Check 阶段, 任一通过都将重构 buyback 数学。但两者均未进入正式投票, 论坛阶段 RFC 拖延数月是常态。热帖中未见 real-yield 提案, 而这才是真正的 regime change 触发器。1-4 周基础判断: 反弹动能衰竭, 价格均值回归至 $5.96 锚点。策略上做空反弹, 保留仓位等 v4 费用投票落地。
